_comment: Banned CONTENT in client-facing demo material, sourced from client directives.
Distinct from banned LANGUAGE (rule_anti_slop, rule_deliverables), which the
text validators already enforce. A directive that lives in a client's Planner
board or an email is invisible to the write gates until it lands here.
Adding a directive is a data change. Adding an exemption needs a reason.
